description: Maya is coordinating a weekend of help for her grandfather after his hip surgery and must make the final call about where he rests, how he moves around the house, and who handles his clinic trip, with input from her brother Jordan, cousin Leah, and aunt Rosa.

shared_context.S1: Grandfather is recovering at home after hip surgery, and the family is arranging help for the weekend of June 13-14, 2026.
shared_context.S2: His house has bedrooms upstairs and a guest room downstairs, plus a staircase between the floors.
shared_context.S3: A follow-up clinic appointment is scheduled for Saturday, June 13, during the morning.
shared_context.S4: Maya is coordinating the weekend care plan and will make the final call about the arrangements.
shared_context.S5: As part of the family's usual care-planning routine, Maya goes around the table and asks Jordan, Leah, and Rosa each to state any specific care requirement, prior promise, preference, or logistical commitment that should shape the plan, and each person answers before Maya settles it.

PF1.text: Grandfather's visiting nurse told Jordan that he must use a walker and avoid the stairs entirely for this weekend; Jordan has not yet told Maya.

PF2.text: Leah has already promised Grandfather that she will drive him to the follow-up clinic on Saturday, June 13, arriving there at exactly 09:30; she has not yet told Maya.

PF3.text: Grandfather privately told Rosa that he wants no overnight visitors in the house and would rather have the family leave him settled at home overnight; Rosa has not yet told Maya.

commitments.type: string: clinic_drive or ground_floor_care or other

acceptance_conditions: Grandfather must rest in the downstairs guest room.
The mobility plan must require walker use and no stair use.
Leah must drive Grandfather to the clinic and arrive at exactly 09:30 on June 13, 2026.
The overnight plan must leave Grandfather at home without overnight visitors.
The settlement must include a commitment for Leah's clinic drive.
The settlement must include a commitment covering Grandfather's ground-floor care.
Jordan's nurse information must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'clinic_drive' and c['target'] == 'Leah' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The nurse's instruction changes the resting room from the upstairs bedrooms to the downstairs guest room, changes mobility to walker use with no stairs, and requires a ground-floor-care commitment.
Leah's prior promise changes the clinic assignment to Leah and fixes the arrival time at exactly 2026-06-13 09:30, with a matching clinic-drive commitment.
Grandfather's stated preference changes the overnight plan from family presence to no overnight visitors in the house.
